title: VUA EAC probe snapshot v0.1
description: Read-only EAC conflict detection (proposal 006 R1a, accepted by user ruling U1 with the eight-point approval semantics): the DEFAULT and only capability of this face. One targeted pass over the process table — never a scan of user data, never a write. Findings: EAC-related processes (name/pid, path when readable), the VRChat runtime state (an active VRChat process IS an active session per R4 — terminate is refused in that state), the readiness conclusion with a guidance code (same discipline as the editor matrix), and the honest termination-capability face: with the allowlist empty and no real-machine evidence, termination is UNAVAILABLE (approval-semantics point 2 — 'unverified/unavailable', stronger than a mere closed switch; the closed set here has no other state in v0.1). Fields the probe could not read are null, never guessed. Termination itself is NOT part of this schema: it is a separately confirmed plan step (R1b/R5) with its own frozen face.

vrchatSessionActive.description: R4 conservative rule: a running VRChat process means an active session — termination is refused in this state (from-wide refusal).

path.description: Executable path when the probe could read it; null when unreadable (permission/attribute) — never guessed.

reason.description: Approval-semantics point 2: with the allowlist empty, termination shows unverified/unavailable. The state open set grows only when real-machine evidence produces the first qualified allowlist entry (R2) and the termination face (R1b) is implemented with its own confirmation chain.
